accepted.text: These days, my brother is learning to cook.
Right now, Sara is painting a large blue tree for the school art show.
The room is busy, but everyone is enjoying the project.
Noah is mixing green paint beside her, and Sara is choosing a softer color for the leaves.
This week, the students are learning how to use watercolors.
They are trying new techniques, and they are sharing their brushes.
Sara is not painting every minute; sometimes she is watching the light near the window and thinking about the next part of the picture.
Sara is laughing, and Noah is bringing a cloth.
Across the room, two students are drawing a quiet street, while another group is building a paper bridge.
The art show is tomorrow evening, so the class is also preparing for a future event.
